description: Submission of details pursuant to condition 6 (Construction Method Statement) and condition 10 (Piling) in relation to 25/03860/CONR which gave permission for, "Minor material amendment application S73 permission ref. 21/02912/FUL (as amended by 23/03340/NMA) for the, "Demolition of existing building and redevelopment of the site to provide a part 14 storey and part 28 storey building with basement, comprising coliving units and associated communal amenity spaces (Use Class Sui Generis), residential units (Use Class C3), commercial space (Use Class E) and flexible commercial and community space (Use Class E/F1) at ground/mezzanine level, together with roof terraces and balconies, wheelchair accessible parking spaces, refuse and cycle storage and associated landscaping and public realm works including removal of subways. Works include stopping up of section of highway on Altyre Road and subway to No.1 Croydon, 12- 16 Addiscombe Road under Section 247 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended)" to allow alterations to the following:.Design.Massing.Relocation of sub-station.Relocation of plant.Internal layouts and amenity spaces.20 additional co-living units.Reconfiguration of Class E and Class E/F1"
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
